description: Defines the LeaveLeaveEntitlement class, representing an entitlement to leave days for a specific leave type within the OrangeHRM system. Contains properties for leave details, entitlement, and length of days, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveLeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Entity class representing the leave entitlement details, with properties mapped to a database table and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity with this entitlement.

methods.name: setEntitlement
methods.description: Associates a LeaveEntitlement entity with this leave entitlement.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days of leave entitlement.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days of leave entitlement.
